changes.section: Weapon and Equipment Skill Fixes and Balance Adjustments
changes.change_text: Inject Venom: Additional-use skill effect changed.
sub_lines: Previous: When an attack succeeds against a target with 20 Poison stacks, consumes 10 Poison stacks and increases Heavy Attack Damage by 20% for 6 seconds.
Updated: When an attack hits a target with 20 Poison stacks, increases Heavy Attack Damage by 20% for 6 seconds.

changes.section: Weapon and Equipment Skill Fixes and Balance Adjustments
changes.change_text: Inject Venom Specialization 1 [Lightning Infusion]: Additional-use skill effect changed.
sub_lines: Previous: When an attack succeeds against a target with 20 Thundercloud stacks, consumes 10 Thundercloud stacks and increases Critical Damage by 15% for 6 seconds.
Updated: When an attack succeeds against a target with 20 Thundercloud stacks, increases Critical Damage by 15% for 6 sec.

changes.section: Weapon and Equipment Skill Fixes and Balance Adjustments
changes.change_text: Weapon Mastery [Venomous Edge]: Fixed an issue where attack power increase effects equivalent to base damage were not applied to Venomous Edge skill damage.

changes.section: Weapon and Equipment Skill Fixes and Balance Adjustments
changes.change_text: Skill Core: Support Fire: The 30% PvP damage reduction effect has been removed from Quick Fire, Recoil Shot, Wave Shot, and Explosive Arrow.

changes.section: Weapon and Equipment Skill Fixes and Balance Adjustments
changes.change_text: Chain Strike - [Smash Down]: Hit range increased from 4m to 5m. An effect has been added so Chain Strike – Smash Down can be used while using the Earthquake skill.

changes.section: Weapon and Equipment Skill Fixes and Balance Adjustments
changes.context_line: Mobility Strike Specialization 2 [Mobility Enchant]: Specialization name changed to [Range Increase]. Required points reduced from 5 to 3. The effect of the Specialization has been adjusted:
changes.change_text: Previous: Mobility Strike - Can now charge while moving. Afterimage - Attack range increases by 20%.
sub_lines: Updated: Afterimage - Attack range increases by 20%. Mobility Strike can now be charged while moving by default, without the need for a specific Specialization.

changes.section: Weapon and Equipment Skill Fixes and Balance Adjustments
changes.skill_or_mechanic_name: Sweep Specialization 3 [Movement Speed and Range Increase]
changes.change_text: Sweep Specialization 3 [Movement Speed and Range Increase]: Movement Speed bonus has increased from 25% to 50%.

changes.section: Weapon and Equipment Skill Fixes and Balance Adjustments
changes.change_text: Explosive Flurry: New specialization [Cooldown Reduction] has been added. Requires 5 points. Reduces Explosive Barrage skill cooldown by 15%, and each Explosive Flurry hit reduces One-Inch Punch's remaining cooldown by 5%.

changes.section: Weapon and Equipment Skill Fixes and Balance Adjustments
changes.change_text: Explosive Flurry Specialization 2 [Range Increase]: Required points reduced from 5 to 3.

changes.section: Weapon and Equipment Skill Fixes and Balance Adjustments
changes.change_text: Consecutive Claws: Improved so the skill can be used while jumping.

changes.section: Weapon and Equipment Skill Fixes and Balance Adjustments
changes.change_text: Skill Core: Fear Erosion: Fixed an issue where the movement speed and defense reduction values were applied incorrectly when Fear Erosion was active, and the values in the effect tooltip were incorrect.

changes.section: Weapon and Equipment Skill Fixes and Balance Adjustments
changes.change_text: Flash Arrow Specialization 1 [Flash Wave]: Fixed an issue where the effect was occasionally not applied to the caster when moving backwards or used from an elevated location.

changes.section: Weapon and Equipment Skill Fixes and Balance Adjustments
changes.skill_or_mechanic_name: Skill Core: Torrent, Eye of Ventius
changes.change_text: Skill Core: Torrent, Eye of Ventius: Monster Damage Amplification value now grows with the respective Skill level. Fixed an issue where the stated damage increase against Monsters was displayed as a sum which included the original skill's monster damage amplification.
sub_lines: Torrent: The damage increase value displayed has been reduced from 185% to 50%.
Eye of Ventius: The damage increase value displayed has been reduced from 260% to 50%.

changes.section: Weapon and Equipment Skill Fixes and Balance Adjustments
changes.change_text: Skill Core: Gale Arrow: Fixed an issue causing Gale Arrow to share a cooldown with Flash Arrow.

changes.section: Weapon and Equipment Skill Fixes and Balance Adjustments
changes.change_text: Blitz Specialization 1 [Limit Break]: Fixed an issue causing the DoT effect from Decisive Sniping to ignore Defense and Evasion when enhanced with Limit Break.

changes.section: Weapon and Equipment Skill Fixes and Balance Adjustments
changes.change_text: Inner Peace: Fixed an issue where the description for Specialization 1 [Thunder's Blessing] was incorrectly applied to [Inner Peace].

changes.section: Weapon and Equipment Skill Fixes and Balance Adjustments
changes.change_text: Skill Core: Thunder's Shadow: Damage increased from 60% to 120%.

changes.section: Weapon and Equipment Skill Fixes and Balance Adjustments
changes.change_text: Skill Core: Lightning Condensation: Damage increased from 90% to 180%. Growth values per skill level have been adjusted to match [Inner Peace].

changes.section: Weapon and Equipment Skill Fixes and Balance Adjustments
changes.change_text: Skill Core: Thunderclouds Explosion: Damage increased from 60% to 120%. Fixed an issue where the stated PvP damage reduction effect was not applied. Monster Damage Amplification display changed from 50% to 150%. Growth values per skill level have been adjusted to match [Inner Peace].

changes.section: Weapon and Equipment Skill Fixes and Balance Adjustments
changes.change_text: Skill Core: Absolute Zero: Frost Smokescreen's cooldown is now properly reduced based on the skill's level while the Absolute Zero Skill Core is equipped.

changes.section: Weapon and Equipment Skill Fixes and Balance Adjustments
changes.change_text: Mastery [Nightmare]: Description has been updated to include Nightmare Melody in the list of skills that trigger the effect.

changes.section: Weapon and Equipment Skill Fixes and Balance Adjustments
changes.change_text: Skill Core: Magic Circle Expansion: Fixed an issue where the cooldown reduction value was displayed as seconds instead of a percentage.

changes.section: Weapon and Equipment Skill Fixes and Balance Adjustments
changes.change_text: Skill Core: Nightmare Melody: Added sleep duration increase effect when leveling the respective skill.

changes.section: Weapon and Equipment Skill Fixes and Balance Adjustments
changes.skill_or_mechanic_name: Rising Slash / Cross Cut Specialization 4 [Slaughtering Slash]
changes.change_text: Rising Slash / Cross Cut Specialization 4 [Slaughtering Slash]: Fixed an issue where, when the final attack of [Rising Slash] or an attack from [Slaughtering Slash] hit a target with Weaken: Brand, the skill cooldown was reduced by up to 15 sec based on stacks of Weaken: Burst, Ignite, and Shock.
